name: masthead
description: The AI-native, Ghost-compatible blog and newsletter that runs on Cloudflare Workers, D1 and R2.

scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/worker deploy
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/admin/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:leaks: bun scripts/leak-guard.ts && gitleaks git . --no-banner --redact --config .gitleaks.toml && gitleaks git . --pre-commit --no-banner --redact --config .gitleaks.toml
